body.message:
Good news on the fees, it's all-inclusive, so water, electricity, internet, and VAT are covered in the rent. The only extra is the AED 2,000 refundable deposit at the end.

One thing worth knowing for a stay through to May/June: rates are confirmed in 3-month blocks and reviewed against market conditions after each period. Want me to send the full listing with photos so you can see the place properly?
